thread.title: Here are Tuesday’s biggest stock-market losers - MarketWatch

author: Philip van Doorn
title: Here are Tuesday’s biggest stock-market losers - MarketWatch
text:
Trading in the U.S. stock market started on a sour note Tuesday, following disappointing earnings reports from two venerable industrial companies and a sell-off in Chinese markets.
The Dow Jones Industrial Average DJIA, -1.65% was down as much as 1.8% in early trading, while the S&P 500 Index SPX, -1.68% dropped as much as 1.7% and the Nasdaq Composite Index COMP, -1.86% fell as much as 2.1%. Those declines followed a reversal for China’s Shanghai Composite Index SHCOMP, -2.26% which was down 2.3% after a two-day rally.
U.S. investors didn’t react well to Caterpillar’s CAT, -7.25% third-quarter earnings report, which included much lower-than-expected earnings guidance for 2018 . They were similarly disappointed by 3M MMM, -6.70%
